package mini

import (
	"math"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"unsafe"
)

func getfp() uintptr

// Counters of what the callbacks saw.
var (
	cbCalls   atomic.Int64
	grew      atomic.Int64
	shrank    atomic.Int64
	traceOK   atomic.Int64
	fpWalkOK  atomic.Int64
	traceBad  atomic.Value // string
	sink      atomic.Pointer[[]byte]
	doReenter = true
)

//go:noinline
func growStack(n int) int {
	var buf [1024]byte
	buf[n%1024] = byte(n)
	if n == 0 {
		return int(buf[0])
	}
	return growStack(n-1) + int(buf[n%1024])
}

func hostResult(ssp, depth uint64, x float64) uint64 {
	return math.Float64bits(x)>>7 ^ depth*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 ^ ssp
}

// hostCB is the Go callback that C reaches through call_host_cb.
func hostCB(ssp, depth uint64, x float64) uint64 {
	cbCalls.Add(1)
	var y byte
	p0 := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&y))
	r := hostResult(ssp, depth, x)
	if doReenter && int64(depth) > 0 {
		u, tag := c_outer(ssp+256, r, depth, x*0.5, depth-1)
		r ^= u + tag*3
	}
	checkFrames()
	// Grow: about 400 KiB of Go frames above the live C frames.
	growStack(400)
	p1 := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&y))
	if p1 != p0 {
		grew.Add(1)
	}
	// Garbage, then GC with most of the stack unused, so GC shrinks it.
	for i := 0; i < 64; i++ {
		b := make([]byte, 4096)
		sink.Store(&b)
	}
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
	p2 := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&y))
	if p2 != p1 {
		shrank.Add(1)
	}
	return r
}

// checkFrames unwinds with the runtime (as GC, panics and profiles do) and
// by walking the frame pointer chain (as the execution tracer does).
func checkFrames() {
	pcs := make([]uintptr, 128)
	n := runtime.Callers(1, pcs)
	var names []string
	fr := runtime.CallersFrames(pcs[:n])
	for {
		f, more := fr.Next()
		names = append(names, f.Function)
		if !more {
			break
		}
	}
	s := strings.Join(names, " ")
	if strings.Contains(s, "mini.call_host_cb mini.c_outer") && strings.Contains(s, "mini.runOuter") {
		traceOK.Add(1)
	} else {
		traceBad.Store("callers: " + s)
	}
	// Collect the PCs first with no calls in the loop: a call could grow
	// the stack and leave fp pointing into the old one.
	var raw [200]uintptr
	nraw := 0
	fp := getfp()
	for nraw < len(raw) && fp != 0 {
		raw[nraw] = *(*uintptr)(unsafe.Pointer(fp + 8))
		nraw++
		fp = *(*uintptr)(unsafe.Pointer(fp))
	}
	var fpn []string
	for _, pc := range raw[:nraw] {
		if f := runtime.FuncForPC(pc - 1); f != nil {
			fpn = append(fpn, f.Name())
		}
	}
	t := strings.Join(fpn, " ")
	if strings.Contains(t, "mini.call_host_cb mini.c_outer") && strings.Contains(t, "mini.runOuter") {
		fpWalkOK.Add(1)
	} else {
		traceBad.Store("fp walk: " + t)
	}
}
